description: Complete catalog of official public, governmental, school, bank, workday, Christian, and Hebrew holidays of Sudan (السودان) — extracted from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation. السودان/As-Sudan (Sudan). Republic of the Sudan — independence 1956. Country code: SD. Categories: public. Multilingual names (2 languages: ar_SD, en_US). End-of-string `(estimated)/(observed)` parentheticals stripped from name columns and lifted into per-record `is_estimated`/`is_observed` boolean flags (per-language regex). No subdivisions — single national list.
